rationale: rc_qp_lam010_start5000_every8 is strongest among the two new variants because on the test split it beats rc_qp_lam010 on 12/12 quality metrics and current rc on 7/12 quality metrics.
However, rc_qp_lam010_start5000_every8 beats base on only 3/12 test quality metrics and only 1/2 test consistency scenes, so it does not satisfy the quality-preserving objective.
rc_qp_lam005 is weaker: it beats base on 0/12 test quality metrics and loses to rc_qp_lam010 on most quality metrics.
Both new variants lose to current rc and rc_qp_lam010 on test consistency in both scenes, indicating pure weight/schedule changes do not preserve enough consistency.
The next useful candidate should change the RC logic, not just the scalar schedule: compare only geometrically comparable reflection pairs via angle-aware or confidence-gated RC.
